rows.name: SALTEES LIGHT-VES.
rows.character: One revol. bright lt., 3 flashes once ev. min.
rows.description: By day shows one mast with ball, and jigger mast. Fog-trumpet, blowing 5 secs., silent 29 secs., then blowing 5 secs., silent 4½ min.

rows.name: TUSKAR
rows.description: Circular white tower, 110 ft. high. A flash of 10 secs. every 1 min.; bright, bright, and red alternately. Fog-bell and rockets

rows.name: LUCIFER SHOALS LT.-V.
rows.description: In 21 fathoms, 2½ miles E. of shoals; has 3 masts; globe, and light, at main. Gong

rows.name: BLACKWATER BK. LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 19 fathoms, 3 miles E. ½ S. from black buoy; has 3 masts; 2 globes at main. Gong

rows.name: ARKLOW BANK S. LT.-VESSEL
rows.character: One br. rev. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 25 fathoms, 2 miles from S. end of bank; has 3 masts; light, and half globe, over globe at main. Gong

rows.name: ARK[?]OW BANK N. LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 18 fathoms, 3½ miles S.E. by E. from N. end of bank; has 3 masts, lights, and gl[?]bes, on main and fore. Gong. (To be altered in spring of 1879 to revol. lt., showing 2 flashes once in every minute

rows.name: CODLING BANK LT.-V.
rows.description: In 9 fathoms, at 4½ miles S.S.E. [?] E. from S. end of bank; has 3 masts; globe over half globe at main. Gong

rows.name: KISH LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 10 fms., ¾ mile off N. end of Kish Bank. Fog-gun, 2 discharges once in every ½ hour

rows.name: Vanguard Wreck
rows.description: Lt.-ves. painted gr'n 2 cables E.S.E. from the wreck of the Vanguard, which lies 8[?] miles S. 24° E. from Kish lt.-ves. Gong

rows.name: Kingstown, East Pier
rows.description: Tower, 41 ft. high; white and red flashes alternately. Masked N. of S.E. ½ S., to clear Muglin Rocks. A fog-bell

rows.name: North Wall, East end
rows.description: One bright lt. A red ray to S., across river channel

rows.name: Poolbeg
rows.description: At mouth of River Liffey. Small lower lt. from half flood to half ebb Fog Bell

rows.name: HOWTH-BAILEY
rows.description: White to[?]er, 42 ft. high, on S.E. pt. of Howth Peninsula. Fog Horn, 5 secs. every 20 secs.

rows.name: Balbriggan
rows.description: White tower, 53 ft. high, on pier, South side of entrance

rows.name: ROCKABILL
rows.character: One br. and red flash. lt.
rows.description: Tower, 105 ft. high; flash every 12 secs.; br. seaward, from S. ½ E. to N.E. by N.; red to westward

rows.name: Drogheda
rows.character: Two fixed br., 1 red lt. One green, five br. lts.
rows.description: On sandhills, S of River Boyne. Changeable as sandbank shifts. E. & W. lts. in one, lead in On perches in inner channel
